method: Small unblinded AI visual review of displayed contact sheets, without independent raters or a semantic classifier.
uncertainty: No class-accuracy estimates. Fine 64px details and obscured/atypical source views can be uncertain. Selected tails are not representative incidence estimates.
conclusion: Both directions shift the fixed appearance axis but do not reliably isolate appearance from background and fine-content changes. Completion at 20000 updates is not a convergence claim.
